name: Vorapaxar Sulfate

examples.title: Trial to Assess the Effects of Vorapaxar (SCH 530348; MK-5348) in Preventing Heart Attack and Stroke in Particpants With Acute Coronary…
examples.why: The trial was terminated at the request of the Data and Safety Monitoring Board.

summary: A small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave Vorapaxar Sulfate a high risk score of 70 for the liver and a low risk score of 33 for the heart [M]. One human study designed to see if the drug could prevent heart attacks and strokes was stopped early [4]. This trial was ended specifically at the request of the Data and Safety Monitoring Board [4].
